sources.title: AI Video Captioning in Nepali Using Transformers - GitHub
sources.snippet: Overview This project addresses the challenge of automatic video description in a low-resource language — Nepali. The system takes a video as input and outputs a descriptive caption in Devanagari script, without any intermediate English translation step.

sources.title: Captioner System | ostris/ai-toolkit | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Captioner System Relevant source files The Captioner System is an automated pipeline within the AI Toolkit designed for dataset preparation. It allows users to generate high-quality descriptive captions for raw images, videos, and audio files, which are essential for training diffusion and multimodal models.
